profile:
COMPANY NAME: RingCentral
INDUSTRY: Cloud Communications / Unified Communications as a Service (UCaaS) / Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS)
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: An Agentic Voice AI platform that provides cloud-based business phone, video meetings, and contact center solutions. It integrates AI agents to automate, assist, and analyze customer interactions across voice, SMS, and chat.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Businesses of all sizes, ranging from SMBs to large enterprises (including global brands like T-Mobile, Vodafone, and Restoration Hardware).
PRICING MODEL: Subscription / Enterprise
KEY FEATURES:
- Agentic Voice AI (AI Receptionist, AI Representative, AI Virtual Assistant) for 24/7 call handling and intent-based automation.
- Unified Communications (RingEX) including business phone, SMS, team chat, and AI-powered video meetings.
- AI Contact Center (RingCX) with omnichannel management, AI workforce engagement, and quality management.
- AIR Pro: A no-code platform for building custom conversational AI agents across multiple channels.
- AI Conversation Expert (ACE) for analyzing interactions to uncover insights and improve performance.
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- Named a Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for 12 consecutive years.
- "Agentic Voice AI" approach that creates a self-learning flywheel to automate outcomes and assist agents.
- Scalable and reliable infrastructure trusted by over 600,000 businesses worldwide.
- No-code capability to build custom AI agents using natural language prompts.
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Premium / Innovation-focused
